Predicates:
HasVisa(x) ::: x is an international student in the US with either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
ApplyFor(x, y, z) ::: If x is an international student in the US with a F1 visa, then x needs to apply for y or z to work in the US.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Premises:
∀x (HasVisa(x) → (ApplyFor(x, CPT, OPT))) ::: An international student in the US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
HasVisa(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
ApplyFor(mike, CPT) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
HasVisa(mike) ::: Mike has an F1 visa.
